unitTitle: Be Going To - Will - Present Continuous - It Will Be/There Will Be
scanNote:
GRAMMAR 56-BET. Unit 13 nazariyasi — 'be going to' va 'will' (mashqsiz bet).

Skaner bilan solishtirildi. Ikkala jadval va barcha qoidalar to'g'ri ko'chirilgan:
  BE GOING TO — tasdiq, inkor, savol, qisqa javoblar; Form (3 qoida); Use (2 qoida).
  FUTURE SIMPLE — tasdiq (uzun va qisqa shakl), savol, inkor (uzun va qisqa); Form (3 qoida).

⚠ IKKI KELASI ZAMON — QAChON QAYSI BIRI:
  BE GOING TO — oldindan O'YLANGAN reja yoki niyat
     'I am going to start a computer course.' (qaror allaqachon qabul qilingan)
  BE GOING TO — HOZIRGI DALILGA asoslangan bashorat
     'There are dark clouds in the sky. It's going to rain.' (bulutlarni KO'RIB turibmiz)
  WILL — shu payt qabul qilingan qaror yoki oddiy bashorat
  ⚠ Farqi: 'going to' da REJA yoki DALIL bor; 'will' da yo'q.

⚠ HALOL QAYD — BIZ QO'ShGAN IKKI BAND:
  1) 'Look at that boy! He's going to fall off his bike!' — bu misol KITOBDA YO'Q, biz qo'shganmiz. Sababi: 'dalilga asoslangan bashorat' qoidasi bitta misol bilan tushunarsiz qoladi. Bandda 'Qo'shimcha misol' deb belgilangan.
  2) 'will' jadvaliga 'Short answers: Yes, I will. / No, I won't.' qatori qo'shildi. Kitobning 'be going to' jadvalida qisqa javoblar bor, 'will' jadvalida esa yo'q — biz ikkalasini bir xil qilib berdik.
  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri va kitobga zid emas, lekin kitobning o'zida bosilmagan.

⚠ 'WON'T' — QISQARTMA SHAKLI NOTO'G'RI KO'RINADI: 'will not' → 'won't' (wiln't emas). Bu — ingliz tilidagi eng notekis qisqartmalardan biri, chunki u eski 'wol not' shaklidan qolgan.

exercises.instructionEn: Be Going To — Talking about plans and intentions
exercises.instructionUz: Be Going To — Rejalar va niyatlar haqida gapirish
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL — 'BE GOING TO' NING TO'RT
ShAKLI:

 ┌───────────────┬──────────────────────────────┐
 │ AFFIRMATIVE   │ I AM / You ARE / He IS, etc  │
 │ (tasdiq)      │ GOING TO buy a car.          │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ NEGATIVE      │ I'M NOT / You AREN'T /       │
 │ (inkor)       │ He ISN'T, etc                │
 │               │ GOING TO buy a car.          │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ INTERROGATIVE │ AM I / ARE you / IS he, etc  │
 │ (so'roq)      │ GOING TO buy a car?          │
 ├───────────────┼──────────────────────────────┤
 │ SHORT ANSWERS │ Yes, I AM / you ARE /        │
 │ (qisqa javob) │      he IS, etc.             │
 │               │ No, I'M NOT / you AREN'T /   │
 │               │     he ISN'T, etc.           │
 └───────────────┴──────────────────────────────┘


HAR ShAXS UChUN TO'LIQ:

  TASDIQ:
     I AM going to buy a car.      → I'M going to
     You ARE going to buy a car.   → You'RE going to
     He IS going to buy a car.     → He'S going to
     She IS going to buy a car.    → She'S going to
     It IS going to buy a car.     → It'S going to
     We ARE going to buy a car.    → We'RE going to
     They ARE going to buy a car.  → They'RE going to

  INKOR:
     I'M NOT going to buy a car.
     You AREN'T going to buy a car.
     He ISN'T going to buy a car.
     We AREN'T going to buy a car.
     They AREN'T going to buy a car.

  SO'ROQ:
     AM I going to buy a car?
     ARE you going to buy a car?
     IS he going to buy a car?
     ARE they going to buy a car?


ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
  'be going to' da O'ZGARADIGAN QISM faqat
  'BE' fe'li (am / is / are).
  'going to' HECh QAChON o'zgarmaydi.


DIQQAT — 'DO/DOES' KERAK EMAS:
     'Are you going to buy a car?'   ✓
     'Do you going to buy a car?'    ✗
     'I'm not going to buy a car.'   ✓
     'I don't going to buy a car.'   ✗


DIQQAT — QISQA JAVOBDA 'GOING TO' TAKRORLANMAYDI:
     'Are you going to buy a car?'
     'Yes, I AM.'                 ✓
     'Yes, I am going to buy.'    — to'liq javob,
                                    qisqa emas


Bu jadval Coursebook 93-betdagi quti bilan
AYNAN bir xil.

points.en: Affirmative: I am / You are / He is, etc going to buy a car.
points.uz: Tasdiq: I am / You are / He is ... going to buy a car.
points.noteUz:
ega + AM/IS/ARE + GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
'going to' O'ZGARMAYDI.

points.en: Negative: I'm not / You aren't / He isn't, etc going to buy a car.
points.uz: Inkor: I'm not / You aren't / He isn't ... going to buy a car.
points.noteUz:
'NOT' 'be' fe'lidan KEYIN.
'I don't going to' XATO.

points.en: Interrogative: Am I / Are you / Is he, etc going to buy a car?
points.uz: So'roq: Am I / Are you / Is he ... going to buy a car?
points.noteUz:
'BE' fe'li OLDINGA chiqadi.
'Do you going to ...?' XATO.

points.en: Short answers: Yes, I am / you are / he is, etc. No, I'm not / you aren't / he isn't, etc.
points.uz: Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I am ... / No, I'm not ...
points.noteUz:
Qisqa javobda 'going to' TAKRORLANMAYDI —
faqat 'be' fe'li qoladi.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'FORM' QUTISI — UCh QOIDA:


1) TASDIQ ShAKLI:
   'We form the AFFIRMATIVE with the verb TO BE
    (is, am, are) + GOING TO + the BASE FORM of
    the verb.'

   = Tasdiq shaklini 'to be' fe'li (is, am, are)
     + 'going to' + fe'lning ASOSIY shakli bilan
     yasaymiz.

   NAMUNA:
     'He IS GOING TO VISIT his friends.'

   DIQQAT — 'BASE FORM' NIMA:
     Fe'lning lug'atdagi shakli — hech qanday
     qo'shimchasiz:
        visit  ✓   ('visits', 'visiting',
                    'visited' XATO)
        go     ✓
        buy    ✓


2) SO'ROQ ShAKLI:
   'We form the INTERROGATIVE by putting the verb
    TO BE BEFORE the SUBJECT PRONOUN.'

   = So'roq shaklini 'to be' fe'lini EGA
     OLMOShIDAN OLDIN qo'yish bilan yasaymiz.

   NAMUNA:
     Tasdiq: 'HE IS going to visit his friends.'
     So'roq: 'IS HE going to visit his friends?'

   Ya'ni EGA va 'BE' O'RIN ALMAShADI.


3) INKOR ShAKLI:
   'We form the NEGATIVE by putting NOT AFTER the
    verb TO BE.'

   = Inkor shaklini 'not' ni 'to be' fe'lidan
     KEYIN qo'yish bilan yasaymiz.

   NAMUNA:
     'He IS NOT / ISN'T going to visit his
      friends.'

   DIQQAT — QISQARGAN ShAKLLAR:
     is not   → isn't
     are not  → aren't
     am not   → 'm not
        ('amn't' YO'Q — 'I'm not' deyiladi)


UCh QOIDANI ESLAB QOLISh:
     TASDIQ:  ega  +  BE  +  going to + fe'l
     SO'ROQ:   BE  +  ega +  going to + fe'l ?
     INKOR:   ega  +  BE  +  NOT + going to + fe'l

  Ya'ni HAMMASI 'BE' fe'li bilan hal bo'ladi.

points.en: We form the affirmative with the verb to be (is, am, are) + going to + the base form of the verb.
points.uz: Tasdiq shaklini 'to be' fe'li (is, am, are) + 'going to' + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz.
points.noteUz:
'BASE FORM' = fe'lning lug'atdagi shakli,
hech qanday qo'shimchasiz.

points.en: He is going to visit his friends.
points.uz: U do'stlarinikiga bormoqchi.
points.noteUz:
'visit' — ASOSIY shakl.
'going to visits' / 'going to visiting' XATO.

points.en: We form the interrogative by putting the verb to be before the subject pronoun.
points.uz: So'roq shaklini 'to be' fe'lini ega olmoshidan oldin qo'yish bilan yasaymiz.
points.noteUz: EGA va 'BE' O'RIN ALMASHADI.

points.en: Is he going to visit his friends?
points.uz: U do'stlarinikiga bormoqchimi?
points.noteUz:
'He is ...' → 'IS HE ...?'
'Does he going to ...?' XATO.

points.en: We form the negative by putting not after the verb to be.
points.uz: Inkor shaklini 'not' ni 'to be' fe'lidan keyin qo'yish bilan yasaymiz.
points.noteUz:
'not' 'be' dan KEYIN.
Qisqargan: isn't, aren't, 'm not.

points.en: He is not / isn't going to visit his friends.
points.uz: U do'stlarinikiga bormoqchi emas.
points.noteUz:
'am not' → "'m not"
('amn't' shakli YO'Q).

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI — IKKI VAZIFA:


1) KELAJAK REJALARI va NIYATLARI
   'We use BE GOING TO to talk about our FUTURE
    PLANS or INTENTIONS.'

   NAMUNA:
     'I AM GOING TO start a computer course.'
     (Kompyuter kursini boshlamoqchiman.)

   → Bu qarorni ALLAQAChON qabul qilganman.
     Oldindan o'ylangan.


2) HOZIRGI DALILGA ASOSLANGAN BAShORAT
   'We also use BE GOING TO for PREDICTIONS BASED
    ON EVIDENCE IN THE PRESENT.'

   NAMUNA:
     'There are dark clouds in the sky.
      IT'S GOING TO rain.'
     (Osmonda qora bulutlar bor. Yomg'ir yog'adi.)

   → DALIL: qora bulutlar HOZIR ko'rinib turibdi.


IKKI VAZIFANING FARQI:

  1-vazifa — ODAM haqida (reja):
     'I'm going to ...'  'She's going to ...'
     Kimdir biror ishni QILMOQChI.

  2-vazifa — HODISA haqida (bashorat):
     'It's going to rain.'
     'He's going to fall!'
     Biror narsa SODIR BO'LADI — chunki dalil bor.


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR — 2-VAZIFA:

  'Look at that boy! He'S GOING TO fall off his
   bike!'
     DALIL: bola muvozanatini yo'qotdi.

  'The sky is very dark. There'S GOING TO be a
   storm.'
     DALIL: osmon qorayib ketdi.

  'She's driving too fast. She'S GOING TO have an
   accident!'
     DALIL: juda tez haydayapti.


DIQQAT — 'WILL' BILAN FARQI:
  'It'S GOING TO rain.'
     → DALIL bor (qora bulutlar KO'RINIB turibdi)
  'I think it WILL rain.'
     → shunchaki FIKR, dalil YO'Q

  Ikkalasi ham bashorat, lekin ASOSI boshqa.


Bu quti Coursebook 93 va 94-betlardagi
qoidalarni BIRLAShTIRADI.

points.en: We use be going to to talk about our future plans or intentions.
points.uz: 'be going to' ni kelajak rejalari yoki niyatlari haqida gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
Qaror ALLAQACHON qabul qilingan,
oldindan o'ylangan.

points.en: I am going to start a computer course.
points.uz: Kompyuter kursini boshlamoqchiman.
points.noteUz:
Coursebook 93-betdagi Jennining xatida ham
aynan shu gap bor edi.

points.en: We also use be going to for predictions based on evidence in the present.
points.uz: 'be going to' ni hozirgi dalilga asoslangan bashorat uchun ham ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
DALIL — hozir KO'RINIB turgan narsa.
Coursebook 94-betdagi qoida.

points.en: There are dark clouds in the sky. It's going to rain.
points.uz: Osmonda qora bulutlar bor. Yomg'ir yog'adi.
points.noteUz:
DALIL: qora bulutlar hozir ko'rinib turibdi.
SOLISHTIRING: 'I think it WILL rain' —
dalilsiz, shunchaki fikr.

points.en: Look at that boy! He's going to fall off his bike!
points.uz: Ana u bolaga qara! U velosipeddan yiqiladi!
points.noteUz:
Qo'shimcha misol.
DALIL: bola muvozanatini yo'qotdi.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI JADVAL — 'WILL' NING BARCHA ShAKLLARI:

 ┌──────────────┬──────────────┬─────────────────┐
 │ AFFIRMATIVE  │ AFFIRMATIVE  │ INTERROGATIVE   │
 │ (uzun shakl) │ (qisqa shakl)│                 │
 ├──────────────┼──────────────┼─────────────────┤
 │ I will leave │ I'll leave   │ Will I leave?   │
 │ you will     │ you'll leave │ Will you leave? │
 │      leave   │              │                 │
 │ he will      │ he'll leave  │ Will he leave?  │
 │      leave   │              │                 │
 │ she will     │ she'll leave │ Will she leave? │
 │      leave   │              │                 │
 │ it will      │ it'll leave  │ Will it leave?  │
 │      leave   │              │                 │
 │ we will      │ we'll leave  │ Will we leave?  │
 │      leave   │              │                 │
 │ you will     │ you'll leave │ Will you leave? │
 │      leave   │              │                 │
 │ they will    │ they'll      │ Will they       │
 │      leave   │      leave   │      leave?     │
 └──────────────┴──────────────┴─────────────────┘

 ┌──────────────────────┬──────────────────────┐
 │ NEGATIVE (uzun)      │ NEGATIVE (qisqa)     │
 ├──────────────────────┼──────────────────────┤
 │ I will not leave     │ I won't leave        │
 │ you will not leave   │ you won't leave      │
 │ he will not leave    │ he won't leave       │
 │ she will not leave   │ she won't leave      │
 │ it will not leave    │ it won't leave       │
 │ we will not leave    │ we won't leave       │
 │ you will not leave   │ you won't leave      │
 │ they will not leave  │ they won't leave     │
 └──────────────────────┴──────────────────────┘


ENG MUHIM KUZATUV — 'WILL' HECh QAChON
O'ZGARMAYDI:

  'be going to' da 'be' fe'li ega bo'yicha
  o'zgaradi (am / is / are).

  'WILL' da esa HAMMA shaxs uchun BIR XIL:
     I will, you will, he will, she will,
     it will, we will, they will

  Bu — 'will' ni ANChA OSON qiladi.


QISQARGAN ShAKLLAR:
     I will    → I'LL
     you will  → YOU'LL
     he will   → HE'LL
     she will  → SHE'LL
     it will   → IT'LL
     we will   → WE'LL
     they will → THEY'LL

     will not  → WON'T

  DIQQAT: 'will not' → 'WON'T' (o'zgargan shakl!)
  'willn't' shakli YO'Q.


SO'ROQ — 'WILL' OLDINGA ChIQADI:
     'Will I leave?'
     'Will you leave?'
     'Will they leave?'

  Hech qanday 'do/does/did' KERAK EMAS.


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
     'Will you leave?'
     'Yes, I WILL.'  /  'No, I WON'T.'

  DIQQAT: qisqa javobda fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI.

points.en: Affirmative (long form): I will leave, you will leave, he will leave, etc.
points.uz: Tasdiq (uzun shakl): I will leave, you will leave, he will leave ...
points.noteUz:
'WILL' hamma shaxs uchun BIR XIL —
hech qachon o'zgarmaydi.

points.en: Affirmative (short form): I'll leave, you'll leave, he'll leave, etc.
points.uz: Tasdiq (qisqa shakl): I'll leave, you'll leave, he'll leave ...
points.noteUz:
'will' → "'ll" (apostrof + ll).
Og'zaki nutqda deyarli DOIM qisqa shakl.

points.en: Interrogative: Will I leave? Will you leave? Will he leave? etc.
points.uz: So'roq: Will I leave? Will you leave? Will he leave? ...
points.noteUz:
'WILL' OLDINGA chiqadi.
'do/does/did' KERAK EMAS.

points.en: Negative (long form): I will not leave, you will not leave, etc.
points.uz: Inkor (uzun shakl): I will not leave, you will not leave ...
points.noteUz: 'not' 'will' dan KEYIN.

points.en: Negative (short form): I won't leave, you won't leave, etc.
points.uz: Inkor (qisqa shakl): I won't leave, you won't leave ...
points.noteUz:
DIQQAT: 'will not' → 'WON'T' (o'zgargan shakl!).
'willn't' shakli YO'Q.

points.en: Short answers: Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
points.uz: Qisqa javoblar: Ha. / Yo'q.
points.noteUz: Qisqa javobda fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'FORM' QUTISI — UCh QOIDA:


1) TASDIQ ShAKLI:
   'We form the FUTURE SIMPLE with WILL and the
    BASE FORM of the verb.'

   = Kelasi oddiy zamonni 'will' va fe'lning
     ASOSIY shakli bilan yasaymiz.

   NAMUNALAR:
     'He WILL GO to the park.'
     'They WILL BUY a new house.'

   DIQQAT — 'BASE FORM':
     'will GO'      ✓   ('will goes' ✗,
                         'will going' ✗,
                         'will to go' ✗)
     'will BUY'     ✓

   DIQQAT — 3-ShAXS BIRLIKDA HAM '-S' YO'Q:
     'He will GO.'      ✓
     'He will goes.'    ✗
     Bu — modal fe'llarning umumiy qoidasi.


2) SO'ROQ ShAKLI:
   'We form the INTERROGATIVE by putting WILL
    BEFORE the SUBJECT PRONOUN.'

   = So'roq shaklini 'will' ni EGA OLMOShIDAN
     OLDIN qo'yish bilan yasaymiz.

   NAMUNALAR:
     Tasdiq: 'HE WILL go to the park.'
     So'roq: 'WILL HE go to the park?'

     Tasdiq: 'THEY WILL buy a new house.'
     So'roq: 'WILL THEY buy a new house?'

   Ya'ni EGA va 'WILL' O'RIN ALMAShADI.


3) INKOR ShAKLI:
   'We form the NEGATIVE by putting NOT AFTER
    WILL.'

   = Inkor shaklini 'not' ni 'will' dan KEYIN
     qo'yish bilan yasaymiz.

   NAMUNALAR:
     'He WILL NOT / WON'T go to the park.'
     'They WILL NOT / WON'T buy a new house.'


UCh QOIDANI ESLAB QOLISh:
     TASDIQ:  ega  +  WILL  +  ASOSIY fe'l
     SO'ROQ:  WILL +  ega   +  ASOSIY fe'l ?
     INKOR:   ega  +  WILL  +  NOT + ASOSIY fe'l

  'be going to' bilan SOLIShTIRING:
     u yerda 'BE' fe'li o'zgaradi,
     bu yerda 'WILL' O'ZGARMAYDI.


ENG KO'P UChRAYDIGAN XATOLAR:
     ✗ He will goes.       ✓ He will go.
     ✗ He will going.      ✓ He will go.
     ✗ He will to go.      ✓ He will go.
     ✗ Does he will go?    ✓ Will he go?
     ✗ He doesn't will go. ✓ He won't go.
     ✗ He willn't go.      ✓ He won't go.

points.en: We form the future simple with will and the base form of the verb.
points.uz: Kelasi oddiy zamonni 'will' va fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz.
points.noteUz:
'will' dan keyin fe'l HECH QANDAY qo'shimcha
olmaydi: '-s' yo'q, '-ing' yo'q, 'to' yo'q.

points.en: He will go to the park. They will buy a new house.
points.uz: U parkka boradi. Ular yangi uy sotib olishadi.
points.noteUz:
'He will GO' — 3-shaxs birlikda ham '-s' YO'Q.
'He will goes' XATO.

points.en: We form the interrogative by putting will before the subject pronoun.
points.uz: So'roq shaklini 'will' ni ega olmoshidan oldin qo'yish bilan yasaymiz.
points.noteUz:
EGA va 'WILL' O'RIN ALMASHADI.
'do/does' KERAK EMAS.

points.en: Will he go to the park? Will they buy a new house?
points.uz: U parkka boradimi? Ular yangi uy sotib olishadimi?
points.noteUz: 'Does he will go?' XATO.

points.en: We form the negative by putting not after will.
points.uz: Inkor shaklini 'not' ni 'will' dan keyin qo'yish bilan yasaymiz.
points.noteUz:
'will not' → 'WON'T'.
'willn't' shakli YO'Q.

points.en: He will not / won't go to the park. They will not / won't buy a new house.
points.uz: U parkka bormaydi. Ular yangi uy sotib olishmaydi.
points.noteUz: 'He doesn't will go' XATO.

Fe'l ASOSIY shaklda ('-s' yo'q).

patterns.formula: WILL + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?  —  Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
patterns.exampleEn: Will he go to the park? — Yes, he will.
